# Fixture: deliberately violates the color_literal rule.
extends Node

func paint() -> void:
	var box := ColorRect.new()
	box.color = Color(0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
	box.self_modulate = Color.RED
	var accent := "#a7f070"
	print(accent)

func not_a_violation(style: Resource) -> Variant:
	# Reading a colour out of style data is the supported way to have one.
	return style.get("outline_color")
